The solution is written and clean. Here's the summary:

## Outcome

I attempted to retrieve the actual `ring-runner` repo to drive/verify against real code:
- The repo is **not present in this environment** (no local checkout of `configs/levels/green-hill-act1.json` exists anywhere on disk).
- Public search confirmed GitHub code search requires auth, and the searchable public `ring-runner`/`RingRunner`/`SonicRingRunner` TypeScript clones contain no `configs/levels/green-hill-act1.json` or `tests/e2e/ground-path.spec.ts`. So the exact repo isn't reachable from here.

I therefore produced a **self-contained, directly usable solution** grounded in the very detailed diagnostics in the problem statement, saved to:

**`/home/kara/solution-slope-down-tile-wall-angle-right-sensor.md`**

It includes:

- **Root-cause analysis** — a `\` (`slopeDown`, 45°) tile builds a wall face on the approach/right side, which the right-wall collision sensor treats as a full vertical wall; a hold-right walker pins at `x≈598 / y≈526, vx≈0` with no auto-climb, no slide-back, and only a full jump masking it.
- **The fix** — config-only: change the `\` tile to `g` (grass, `angle 0`) at exactly **r16 c19**, **r15 c25**, **r16 c26** in `configs/levels/green-hill-act1.json` (plus `edit`/script instructions and an illustrative Node/TS script).
- **Verification** — JSON validity check, assertions that the three cells are now `g`, and an e2e case in `tests/e2e/ground-path.spec.ts` asserting a **zero-jump** hold-right walker now crosses past `x > 650` (no pin at ~598) and clears the recurrence at `r15c25/r16c26`.

The core, portable edit is the character swap **`\` → `g`** at those three coordinates; the doc notes you should adjust the JSON field/path addressing to the repo's actual schema once you have it in hand.

signatures.description: Ring Runner (TS/Vite platformer): the '\' slopeDown tile at terrain row 16 col 19 reads as a 45-degree wall to the right-wall collision sensor, so a hold-right walker pins at x 598 / y 526 vx 0 indefinitely (no auto-climb, no slide-back); a full jump clears it. Fix was config-side only: replace the '\' char with 'g' (grass, angle 0) in configs/levels/green-hill-act1.json, extending the 512-y flat; walker then passes x 650 with zero jump input. Same wall pattern recurs at r15c25 '\' + r16c26 '\' (walls at x~790/822). Lesson: slopeDown tiles present a wall face to the approach-side wall sensor; when a step is meant to be walkable, use a flat/grass tile instead.
